events.title: Destash Market — Arts, Crafts & Sewing Supplies
events.description: A gathering for local creatives to buy and trade art, craft, and sewing supplies, hosted by the Caloundra Arts Centre Association. It is a practical community event for makers to source materials and meet fellow hobbyists.

events.title: Bloom — Opening event
events.source: The Little Red Cottage (art + ecology space)
events.description: The opening celebration for an art and ecology exhibition dedicated to local wildflowers. It is an intimate event at a community-focused space that bridges environmental appreciation and artistic expression.

events.title: Bloom — Exhibition
events.source: The Little Red Cottage (art + ecology space)
events.description: A recurring exhibition exploring the intersection of local ecology and art through the lens of wildflowers. Ideal for those interested in botany, local environment, and creative displays.

events.title: Pattemore House Open Day
events.description: An opportunity to explore a historic homestead, meet the volunteers from the Maleny Historical Society, and learn about the local history of the region. Provides a window into past lifestyles and community preservation.

events.title: Maleny Fix It Cafe
events.source: Maleny Fix It Cafe / Maleny Neighbourhood Centre
events.description: A community repair workshop where locals bring broken items to be fixed by skilled volunteers. It fosters a circular economy mindset and encourages conversation between residents.

events.title: Level 1 — Foundations Of Integral Sound Healing
events.description: A hands-on workshop exploring the science and practice of sound healing. Focuses on the foundational principles of how sound affects the human experience through an immersive approach.

events.title: Grassroots to Glory: Around the Track
events.description: A historical exhibition detailing local racing and grassroots community culture. Offers an insight into the cultural evolution of the Sunshine Coast's regional life.

events.title: Ranger guided Wildflower Walk
events.description: A guided educational walk through a rare botanical scientific area led by park rangers. Focuses on identification, ecology, and the conservation of regional flora.

events.title: Guided walk — Proteaceae & Banksias
events.description: A specialized guided botanical walk through the bushland gardens, focusing on the Proteaceae and Banksia families. Offers a deep dive into specific plant species for those curious about biology and native horticulture.

events.title: Glasshouse Mountains Flora Workshop
events.description: A technical workshop led by the Wallum Study Group focusing on the unique flora of the Glasshouse Mountains region. Ideal for those interested in botany, environment, and regional biodiversity.

events.title: The Big Bike Film Night
events.description: A selection of short films focused on cycling, adventure, and human-powered stories. It gathers a community of cycling enthusiasts and film lovers for a night of curated cinema.
